solat.name: Waktu solat
solat.description: Prayer times for your area, with a countdown to the next one.
solat.privacy: Sends your prayer time area to e-Solat (www.e-solat.gov.my), or to api.waktusolat.app if e-Solat is down. About once a month.
solat.liveBefore: Show on the notch before each prayer
solat.liveBeforeHint: The notch shows the countdown this many minutes before. At 0 it shows only when the time comes.
solat.reminderHint: A short alert on the notch at each prayer time.
solat.ramadanHint: Counts down to imsak and to breaking the fast.
solat.needsArea: Pick your area on the Prayer times page in Settings.
solat.stale: Prayer times are out of date. Atap will try again soon.
solat.alert.imsak: Imsak. Time to start the fast
solat.alert.berbuka: Maghrib. Time to break the fast
